{{Top|leg}}
The '''Time of Wandering''' was a ritual undertaken by many [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinians]]. Those who undertook the ritual were left alone in the [[Derelkoos Desert]] in an attempt to strengthen them. Those that survived were generally sold to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]].<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref>
